Text: The Bonferroni correction is a statistical adjustment method used to reduce the likelihood of false positives, or Type I errors, when multiple comparisons are made. For example, if the standard alpha is 0.05 and ten tests are conducted, the adjusted alpha for each test would be 0.005.
